# Co-operation Society Nepal (CSN)

> Co-operation Society Nepal is a youth-led, non-profit social development organisation established in 2013 and based in Nuwakot, Nepal.

## Organization

- Official name: Co-operation Society Nepal (CSN)
- Registration: Regd. No. 401/81, District Administration Office, Nuwakot
- Social Welfare Council affiliation: No. 37085
- Head office: Bidur-4, Battar, Nuwakot, Nepal
- Contact office: Budhanilkantha-6, Kathmandu
- Working districts: Nuwakot, Rasuwa, Dhading and Kathmandu; project reach also includes Tanahun, Syangja and Makawanpur.
- Main email: csnnepal@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.csnnepal.org.np/

## Programs

CSN works in child protection, education, women's rights, health, water and sanitation, livelihoods, disaster risk reduction, agriculture, environment, tourism and community development.
